description: image_index catch-all (issue #4141) — matches ANY imageId (predicate '~' = empty-substring match) and answers an empty index list, so a call no specific fixture covers degrades to 'nothing indexed on this page' instead of fixture_not_found. MUST be ordered LAST among the image-index fixtures in a test's mcp_fixtures. Stocked on the research tests that run search-images live, because the agent holds image_index and the runnability gate requires a fixture for every tool a live agent can call. Mirrors image-search-any.
